help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:278  The first line answers the question the timer cannot: it reads the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:279  `run-state.json` written by the last `run-once` pass. Three distinct
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:280  answers, and only the first is a healthy one:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:281  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:282  * last run recent and successful -> exit 0
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:283  * last run FAILED -> exit 1, saying which step failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:284  * no run recorded at all, or nothing has run for longer than
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:285    4x `backup_interval_secs` (minimum 1 hour) -> exit 1. A dead timer
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:286    usually leaves a *successful* last run behind, so this overdue check
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:287    is the only thing that catches it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:288  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:289  Never prints session content: counts, timestamps and digests only.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:389  Prove the archive is intact. Three independently runnable levels:

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:424  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:428  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:429  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:430  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:431  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:432  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:433  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:434  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:435  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:436  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:437  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:438  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:440  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:441  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:444  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:447  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:450  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:453  Existing destination to compute the difference set against,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:454  repeatable. Default: every other destination in the config.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:457  Repository path override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:460  Masterkey file override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:463  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:466  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:469  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:472  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:473  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:474  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:475  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:479  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:480  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:481  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:482  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:483  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:484  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:485  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart. Use
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:486  `--cost` to see what a full-text pass over the current hits *would*
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:487  cost before asking for one; full-text matching is not implemented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:488  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:489  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:490  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:491  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:492  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:493  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:494  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:495  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:496  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:497  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:498  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:499  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:500  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:501  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:502  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:503  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:504  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:505  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:506  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:507  destination and answered for every session and nothing matched, `3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:508  could not finish — either reading it, or placing every session in time —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:509  so "nothing matched" is unproven. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:511  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:514  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:518  three groups (matched / not matched / could not be placed) stay
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:519  separate fields, so a consumer cannot read an unknown as an absence.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:541  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:542

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:544  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:545  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:548

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:550  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:554  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:555  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:556  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:557  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:558  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:559  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:560  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:561  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:562  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:563  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:564  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:566  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:567  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:568  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:569  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:570  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:571  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:572  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:573  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:574  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:575  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:576  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:578  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:584  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:587  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:588  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:589  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:598  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:599  from an earlier export stay where they are.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:622  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:623  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:624  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:625  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:626  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:627  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:628  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:629  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:630  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:631  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:632  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:633  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:634  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:635  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:636  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:637  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:638  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:639  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. Conversation
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:640  text is fetched and decrypted only when you click a session and then
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:641  click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit codes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:642  match `search`: 0 served the dashboard, 1 read it all and there was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:643  nothing, 3 could not finish reading (or no key), 2 usage error.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:648  Consume ext inbox bundles into sealed staging shards.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:654  bytes are never archived twice. Prints paths/counts/sha256 only.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:672

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:674  durable byte offset plus committed-prefix SHA-256; opencode SQLite
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:675  sessions use a durable logical high-water cursor. The cursor state lives

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:677  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:678  Exit codes: 0 = every recognised session was archivable and was

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:692  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  Named destination from the config. Read state is kept per
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:696  destination, so a different destination is a different debt set.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:703  Masterkey file override for the destination above.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:707  Seal one file already inside our stage into the next sealed-shard slot.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:708  This command never renames a harness-owned path.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:718  Registry harness id that owns the active file (e.g. `claude-code`).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:725  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:733  Session id to seal into. Default: the active file's stem.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:736  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:740  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:741  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:742  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:743  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:744  This command retires the shard body once every declared destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:745  proves it holds each session. Proof means asking the archive itself —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:746  never the local cursor — for every session's digest triple (shard
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:747  count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and matching it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:748  against the stage. A destination that cannot be consulted is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:749  "unproven" and blocks the reclaim: it is never treated as "does not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:750  have it". Every declared destination must prove it holds each session,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:751  or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:752  nothing is deleted.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:753  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:754  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:755  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:756  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:757  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:758  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:759  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:760  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:761  blocked — at least one destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:762  to hold a session, so nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:764  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:767  Actually delete the proven shard body. Default: dry run (report only).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:786  Register this executable as the browsers' Native Messaging host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:787  (ADR-014 step 2) — or, with `--uninstall`, remove that registration.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:788  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:789  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:790  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:791  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:792  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:793  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:794  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:795  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:796  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:797  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:798  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:799  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:800  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:801  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:802  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:803  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:804  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:805  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:806  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:807  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:808  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:810  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:811  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:812  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:816  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:817  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:823  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:824  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:825  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:828  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:831  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:834  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:837  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:840  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:843  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:844  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:845  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:846  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:847  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:848  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:852  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:853  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:854  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:855  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:856  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:857  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:858  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:859  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:860  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:861  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:862  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:864  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:865  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:866  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:870  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:874  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:875  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:876  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:877  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:878  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:879  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:880  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:881  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:882  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:883  With `--rebuild --destination`, every archived session for that machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:884  is restored to a temporary child of `--stage`, the full index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:885  rebuilt, and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing snapshots
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:886  remain immutable. No snapshot is written until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:887  session restore finish, and only the named machine partition is pushed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:888  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:889  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:890  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:891  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:892  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:893  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:894  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:895  Metadata only: the extraction keeps a timestamp per line and throws the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:896  line away. Nothing else about a conversation is ever read, kept or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:897  printed — the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:898  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:900  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:901  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:903  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:904  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:906  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:907  destination rebuild. Temporary restored shards are removed after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:908  the new snapshot is written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:912  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:913  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916  Explicitly rebuild the complete partition index. The command has
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917  always rebuilt rather than incrementally patched; this spelling is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918  provided for repair workflows and makes that intent visible.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  Destination to rebuild from and append the repaired snapshot to.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  Requires `--rebuild`; either this or `--repo` must be named.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:925  Repository path override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:928  Masterkey file override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:931  Concurrency cap override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:934  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:937  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:941  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:942  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:943  Writes `<stage>/meta/<machine>/machine.json` — a `MachineDeclaration`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:944  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:945  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:946  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:947  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:948  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:949  The display name is taken from `--display-name` when given; otherwise
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:950  the system's LocalHostName (`scutil --get LocalHostName` on macOS,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:951  `hostname` elsewhere) is used. If neither is available the field is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:952  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:953  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:954  Exit codes: `0` = the declaration was written; `3` = the machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:955  partition could not be resolved or the identity is unusable; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:956  file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:958  Stage directory to write the declaration into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:961  Human display name for this machine. Default: system LocalHostName.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:965  Give a dead or sold machine a display name (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:966  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:967  Writes `<stage>/meta/<target>/label-by-<local-identity>.json` — a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:968  `LabelRecord` expressing *this* machine's opinion about what `<target>`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:969  should be called. It exists for machines that can no longer declare for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:970  themselves (sold, dead, in a different building). Each file has exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:971  one writer, so concurrent machines never fight over it; the overview
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:972  shows the label with the latest `written_at_unix`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:973  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:974  Exit codes: `0` = the label was written; `3` = the local identity could
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:975  not be resolved; `1` = the file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:977  Stage directory to write the label into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:980  Machine id (partition) being labelled, e.g. a 32-hex identity.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:983  Display-name override for the target.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:987  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:988  (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:989  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:990  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:991  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:992  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:993  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:994  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:995  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:996  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:997  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:998  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:999  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1000  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1001  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1002  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1003  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1004  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1005  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1006  whole repository was read and there is no activity index at all (a real
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1007  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1008  be read in full (open / snapshot / tree / dump failure) — the absences
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1009  below are unproven; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1011  Destination to open. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1012  there is no default destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1015  Terminal width for the matrix/heatmap (default: 100).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1018  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1019  human matrix/heatmap is suppressed). Per-session `first_unix` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1020  `last_unix` and `time_source` are tri-state tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1021  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` — an unknown
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1022  time is never `null`. `no_index_anywhere` is `true` on exit 1
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1023  (read in full, no index anywhere); a failed read (exit 3) puts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1024  reason in `error`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1027  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1030  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1033  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1036  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1039  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
